hero.title: Raise it safely. We will answer.
hero.subtitle: The public grievance procedure of Kind Health Tech SIA under B Corp PSG 3.1 — how any stakeholder can raise a grievance, exactly what happens next, and the protections that make raising one safe.

raise.title: Six ways in — one per stakeholder group.
raise.lead: Each stakeholder group has its own grievance form, pre-tagged so the matter lands on the right review track. Prefer mail or post? Those work too.

channels.label: Post
channels.value: Kind Health Tech SIA, Registered office, Riga, Latvia — mark it 'Grievance'

channels.label: Officer
channels.value: Saransh Sharma, Director (Founder & CEO) — escalates to the Board where he has a conflict of interest

procedure.title: What we accept, and what happens next.

grounds.title: Grounds for accepting a grievance
grounds.lead: We accept a grievance when the matter meets these tests. You do not need proof to raise one — a clear account is enough to start.
items: It touches our purpose commitments or a stakeholder interest documented on this site
It concerns our conduct, the conduct of an atelier or partner acting for us, or claims made on our platform
It is something within our influence to review, remediate or change

items.title: Acknowledged
items.body: Receipt is confirmed and a reference number is issued. Anonymous grievances are logged with the same reference discipline.

items.title: Assessed
items.body: The grievance officer checks the matter against the grounds and accepts or declines it. A decline always comes with written reasons.

items.title: Resolved
items.body: The officer facilitates a resolution — remediation, mediation or a policy fix — with a status update at least every 10 business days while it stays open.

items.title: Closed & confirmed
items.body: You receive the outcome in writing, the reason for it, and confirmation that the grievance is closed.

items.title: Appeal
items.body: If you disagree with the outcome, the Board reviews it at its next meeting. The officer never adjudicates a grievance about himself.

resolution.title: How a resolution is facilitated
resolution.lead: Resolutions are chosen to fix the harm, not to close the ticket.
items: Direct remediation — corrections, repayments, contract or listing fixes
Mediation — between the complainant and the affected party, where both must agree the fix
Policy change — where the grievance points at a rule, the rule gets reviewed
Board escalation — conflicts of interest, appeals, and anything touching the purpose go to the Board
resolution.note: Every grievance is logged. The log is reviewed quarterly by the Board and annually as part of the purpose review.

protection.title: Raising a grievance must never cost you anything.
protection.lead: These controls apply from the moment a grievance is raised — through the form, by mail, or by post.

items.title: Zero tolerance
items.body: Retaliation is itself a grievable offense and triggers an immediate Board-level review.

items.title: Anonymous by design
items.body: The form works without a name or email; postal submissions need no return address.

items.title: Need-to-know identity
items.body: Where you identify yourself, only the grievance officer sees who you are.

items.title: No consequences
items.body: No impact on payouts, orders, contracts, listing or standing for raising a grievance in good faith.

items.title: Officer with a firewall
items.body: Grievances about the officer — or the founder — go straight to the Board.

accepted.title: If accepted — communicated at every step
items: A status update at least every 10 business days while the grievance is open
The outcome and the reason for it, with confirmation the grievance is closed

declined.title: If not accepted — explained, in writing
declined.body: If we do not accept the issue as a grievance, you receive the reasons in writing within the same 10-business-day deadline — together with the route to have the Board look again.

personas.name: Workers
personas.title: Raise a grievance as a worker.
personas.who: Anyone who works for Kind Health Tech — employee or contractor, in any location.
personas.blurb: Pay, conditions, safety, credit for your work.
examples: Retaliation for raising a concern internally

personas.name: Suppliers
personas.title: Raise a grievance as a supplier.
personas.who: Artisans, ateliers and material suppliers on the platform.
personas.blurb: Payouts, terms, credit for your craft.
examples: Unfair or unclear commission and terms
Craft credited wrongly or used without permission

personas.name: Customers
personas.title: Raise a grievance as a customer.
personas.who: Buyers and brands who purchase through the platform's storefronts.
examples: Product not matching its claims or provenance data

personas.name: Investors
personas.title: Raise a grievance as an investor.
personas.who: Current and prospective backers of the company.

personas.name: Community
personas.title: Raise a grievance as a community member.
personas.who: Anyone in the places we operate — Bagru, Srinagar, Florence, Sydney, Riga, Dharamshala.
examples: Local environmental impact of operations — water, dyes, waste
Impact on craft heritage and community life

personas.name: The environment
personas.title: Raise a grievance on behalf of the environment.
personas.who: Anyone who witnesses an environmental breach in our operations or our partners'.
examples: Dye or water discharge at partner ateliers
Inaccurate environmental claims on any product

criteriaMap.requirement: The company publishes a grievance form on its webpage or has another easily accessible way for stakeholders to raise a grievance
The grievance procedure explains grounds for accepting a grievance, process steps and targeted deadlines, and how a resolution is facilitated
The company describes the processes and controls protecting stakeholders who raise grievances from any form of retaliation
The company responds to grievances by communicating each step and outcome to the complainant, or explains why it was not accepted

footnote: Published in fulfilment of B Corp Certification requirements — Purpose & Stakeholder Governance 3.1 (Criteria 3.1.1–3.1.4). Kind Health Tech is a candidate for certification, not yet a Certified B Corporation.
